We are committed to continually improve OpenVireo through customer experience and your feedback is important to us. Please report any bugs you encounter at our GitHub issue tracker.

OpenVireo is a fork of KeePassXC. Credit and thanks go to the KeePassXC Team and its contributors, who build KeePassXC; please do not report OpenVireo problems to them.

See our contact page for further options.

Thank You,
OpenVireo
